question: Estimate the adoption of EV in last-mile delivery (Swiggy/Zomato/Amazon/Flipkart fleets) by 2028.
idealClarificationQuestions: % of last-mile delivery vehicles being electric (2W + 3W vans) in 2028? Yes.
Fleet partners + own fleet of e-commerce companies? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: EV share today (2026): 2W ~5-7% in delivery (Zypp, Yulu, captive fleets); 3W ~25% (e-rickshaws, Mahindra Treo).
